narrative.overview: Everything on the web reads as one `git aliases` terminal session. The page opens with the command being typed, the CLI's gradient banner prints, and every section after it is either a command and its output or a box the real TUI would draw. Nothing is a picture of a terminal: there is no window chrome, no traffic-light dots and no fake title bar. The page ground is the terminal ground, and the content is set as text a visitor can select and copy.
keyCharacteristics: One self-hosted monospace (Commit Mono) for every role, banner included.
`$` prompts and `#` comment headings; the CLI's own copy (menu items, key hints) shown verbatim.
Rounded 1px boxes only where the CLI draws them: violet around prompts, gray around notes.
A `>` cursor row with a tinted band marks the current choice in every list.
Keyboard parity with the TUI: arrows or j/k move, Enter acts, number keys jump between status-bar windows.

rules.name: The Banner-Only Ramp Rule
rules.body: The cyan-to-purple ramp lives in the banner and nowhere else. No gradient fills, gradient text or gradient buttons.

rules.name: The CLI Source Rule
rules.body: Every accent traces back to a lipgloss style in `main.go` or `banner.go`. A new colour needs a matching CLI use first.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from bold, violet and dim, as in a terminal. Only the banner and the lede step up in size.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A layer is a tonal field or a 1px rule.

dos: Do write sections as commands and their output, or as boxes the CLI actually draws.
Do use the CLI's real copy (menu labels, key names, flag syntax) verbatim.
Do give every list a `>` cursor and TUI keys (arrows, j/k, Enter), plus normal pointer behaviour.
Do keep both colour profiles: dark ground `#13111c`, light ground `#f6f5fa`.
Do theme browser surfaces: violet selection, violet focus ring, a rule-coloured scrollbar.
donts: Don't draw a terminal window frame, traffic-light dots or a fake title bar. The page is the terminal.
Don't use the banner ramp outside the banner.
Don't add shadows or a second typeface.
Don't show output Git or the CLI would not produce without labelling it, as with the aligned `--get-regexp` columns.
